# Excel IMAGE fixture

`excel-image.xlsx` was saved by Excel 16.0 build 20527 on 2026-11-07 in
`external-measurements` job p42. The formulas fetch generated one-pixel GIF and PNG
bytes and a minimal SVG from httpbin's base64 endpoint; A1 and A2 contain cached
pictures and A3 contains the SVG error. SHA-256:
`c0de29e92417e933b11e6a61b7cadef628d3119b9efd5d4636b20494b65de591`.
